etapes.en: In formal English, « if » can be dropped by inverting: Should + subject, Were + subject + to, Had + subject + pp.

exemples.en: Should you need any help, please contact us.
exemples.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'aide, contactez-nous.

exemples.en: Were I to accept, I would need a car.
exemples.fr: Si je devais accepter, il me faudrait une voiture.

exemples.en: Had we known, we would have acted sooner.
exemples.fr: Si nous avions su, nous aurions agi plus tôt.

etapes.question: « Should you have any questions » =
choix: Vous avez dû avoir des questions

etapes.question: Formal version of « If I had known… »

etapes.en: Should you require further information please contact us
etapes.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'informations supplémentaires veuillez nous contacter
Si nous avions reçu votre lettre, nous aurions répondu.
reponses: Had we received your letter, we would have replied.
Had we received your letter, we would have answered.

etapes.en: Prior to the meeting, please read the report.
choix: Avant la réunion, veuillez lire le rapport.
Après la réunion, lisez le rapport.
Pendant la réunion, lisez le rapport.

etapes.en: Should you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact me.
etapes.fr: Si vous avez des questions, n'hésitez pas à me contacter.

resume: Should you…, Were I to…, Had I known… = formal if-clauses. regarding, prior to, subsequently, in accordance with.
devoir: Write a formal letter (10 lines) using two inverted conditionals.
